name: Nginx Proxy Manager
tagline: Managing Nginx proxy hosts with a simple, powerful interface.
description: Nginx Proxy Manager is a simple, powerful tool to help you host multiple websites on a single server.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  nginxproxymanager:
    image: jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:2.13.5
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: "128M"
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "80"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 443
        published: "443"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 81
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /data
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/etc/letsencrypt
        target: /etc/letsencrypt
    container_name: nginxproxymanager
